records.title: Signature mismatch: cn
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `cn` from `cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]): string` to `cn(...inputs: any[]) (no return annotation; returns baseCn(...inputs), the @uitripled/utils cn, so string)`, the signature the source defines at `packages/components/react-shadcn/src/lib/utils.ts:3`.
records.issue: documented `cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]): string`, source `cn(...inputs: any[]) (no return annotation; returns baseCn(...inputs), the @uitripled/utils cn, so string)`: parameter 'inputs' type differs: source any[], documented ClassValue[]. The declaration at this line is the react-shadcn wrapper (lib/utils.ts imports cn as baseCn from @uitripled/utils); the skill documents and cites the @uitripled/utils cn (packages/utils/src/cn.ts:4, (...inputs: ClassValue[]), which matches) and calls this file an identical implementation (references/utils.md:36), importing it in references/integration.md:54

records.title: The react-shadcn UILibrary restriction is described as runtime-only
records.remediation: In references/setup.md line 96 and SKILL.md line 136, say that useUILibrary's UILibrary is the 3-member type of packages/components/react-shadcn/src/types.ts:1 ("shadcnui" | "baseui" | "carbon"), imported at ui-library-provider.tsx:3, so the restriction is in the type.
records.issue: references/setup.md:96 and SKILL.md:136 say UILibraryProvider and useUILibrary reach only shadcnui, baseui and carbon at runtime even though the @uitripled/utils UILibrary includes react; the provider imports the 3-member UILibrary of packages/components/react-shadcn/src/types.ts:1 (ui-library-provider.tsx:3), so setSelectedLibrary("react") is a type error, not only a runtime limit
